title: OpenReview: AI-Powered Code Review Bot by Vercel Labs
summary: An open-source, self-hosted AI code review assistant that provides on-demand pull request analysis and automated fixes. It uses Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Vercel Workflow to execute reviews in sandboxed environments, allowing it to run linters and tests.
research_notes: Employs a progressive skill system to load specialized instructions for specific frameworks like Next.js only when relevant.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from an internal Vercel tool to a public open-source project; currently utilizes Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Vercel Sandbox for high-fidelity code analysis and direct PR fixes.
